meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: Claude 会去读主机日志、会话数据库(inbound.db / outbound.db)、挂载与心跳文件,按排查流程判断容器为什么不回复、认证为什么报错、消息为什么丢失。
howto.when: 当容器启动失败、认证出问题、消息发不出去,或你想弄清容器系统如何运作时接管。

say.text: 容器起来了但没回复,帮我查一下日志
say.note: 会看 nanoclaw 日志与容器 stderr

say.text: 消息没送到,查下这个会话的 outbound.db
say.note: 会查 messages_out 里的记录

say.text: 接口报 401,看下这个 agent 的 secret 模式
say.note: 会查 onecli agents 配置

howto.what_en: Claude reads host logs, session DBs (inbound.db/outbound.db), mount and heartbeat files to trace why a container fails to reply, why auth errors, or why messages are lost.
howto.when_en: Triggers when containers fail, authentication breaks, messages aren't delivered, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Container started but no reply — check the logs
say_en.note: Reads nanoclaw logs and container stderr

say_en.text: Message wasn't delivered — query this session's outbound.db
API returns 401 — check this agent's secret mode
